messages:
amira: Heads-up — seeing token-latency and occasional model OOMs on a small subset of USW1 racks. Symptoms look like PCIe retransmits + NVLINK errors on a couple nodes, but routing fell back traffic into a preemptible pool and blew our cost for the hour :grimacing:
ben-ops: ugh. do we have host IDs or alloc ids?
dani: noticed the same, was replaying traces — fallback policy picked `preemptible-lowcost` instead of `dedicated-hot-ss` because of a weird capacity signal from the allocator. looks like a metric spike made the router mark the warm-pool as unavailable.
amira: root host id is host-uw1-cc42. logs attached in the edge runbook. i pasted the pcie errors earlier: ``[PCIe ERR] AER: Corrected error, severity=Recovered, root=0000:04:00.0``
matt: can we soft-quarantine host-uw1-cc42 and drain its kvcache before evicting? want to avoid cold-start penalty across other tenants.
dani: yeah plan: 1) set host to quarantine (no new allocs) 2) trigger `kvcache::flush-prefixes` for active tenants 3) reassign new requests to same-az dedicated slice
tilly: who can flip quarantine? i can run the drain but need the exact commands.
ben-ops: i'll do it. running: ``./opsctl host quarantine host-uw1-cc42 --reason pcie-aer`` then ``./opsctl drain host-uw1-cc42 --kvcache-flush``
sre-bot: autoscaler detected abnormally high alloc churn and started fallback routing at 2026-03-22T15:07:12Z. Fallback target: preemptible-lowcost.
amira: the important bit — routing logic preferred lowest-cost fallback without considering thermal/pcie health signals. that's the bug. we need to make fallback chooser prefer same-az dedicated variants when health is ambiguous
matt: agree. quick mitigation: add a temporary rule to prefer `dedicated-hot-ss` for customer tiers with SLA. i'll open a canary rollout for the routing filter (50% to start).
dani: cost impact estimate: ~2.8x token cost for traffic switched to preemptible pool for that hour. will send billing snapshot in thread.
tilly: after quarantine i'll watch latency dashboards and confirm kvcache hitrate stays stable.
ben-ops: quarantine + flush done. host now cordoned, vgpus offline for host-uw1-cc42.
amira: thanks. action items: - matt to roll the routing quickfix canary, - infra to add health-signal veto for fallback chooser, - billing to reconcile the 2.8x spike. i'll file a short postmortem if numbers hold. :eyes:
matt: starting canary now (50% to routing-new-filter). will monitor error-rate and cost.
sre-bot: canary started at 2026-03-22T15:12:03Z — routing filter v2 -> 50%
dani: follow-up: we should also surface PCIe AER counts into the allocator health scoring (not just churn). adding to the TODOs.
amira: cool. thanks everyone — ping here when canary is green or if we need rollback.
